title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Members on Ridgeline Pro Credit — Preferred Minimum Payment Percentage
content:
On a Ridgeline Pro Credit revolving account, the recomputed minimum of the latest statement is worked at the preferred minimum percentage, set by the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership and the account's age:

1. When the business holds an active ProBuild Silver, Gold, Platinum or Platinum Elite membership and the account has been open at least **60** whole months, it is the tier's minimum payment percentage less the long-standing member cut of **1.00** percentage point.
2. When the business holds such a membership and the account has been open less than **60** whole months, it is the tier's minimum payment percentage less the newer member cut of **0.50** percentage points.
3. In every other case it is the tier's minimum payment percentage.

## Figures

| Tier | Minimum payment percentage | Long-standing Silver-or-higher member | Newer Silver-or-higher member |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 3.00 | 2.00 | 2.50 |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 2.50 | 1.50 | 2.00 |

(The Commercial Account tiers carry a minimum payment percentage of 100, the full balance, and are not revolving.)

Account age is counted in whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the payment date. The membership is the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership in active status, read by its tier name; a ProBuild Member or Bronze membership, or no active membership, falls in the third case.

## Cases (hypothetical, Pro Revolving Charge)

| Membership | Account open | Preferred minimum percentage |
|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Gold | 60 months | 2.00 |
| ProBuild Silver | 59 months | 2.50 |
| ProBuild Bronze | 90 months | 3.00 |
